::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon="false" title="Purpose"}
Use this guide with the Week 4 readings and class activities. The goal is to
turn descriptive statistics and visuals into a clear story that a specific
audience can understand and act on.
:::

## Objectives

- identify the central message in a quantitative story;
- reduce unnecessary cognitive load in writing and slides;
- make important comparisons visually and verbally obvious;
- provide context that gives a number meaning; and
- adapt statistical communication for a nontechnical business audience.

## Resources

- [Week 4 slides](week_04.qmd)
- the Week 4 communication readings in Canvas
- [Homework 4: Project Story Planning](Homework_04.qmd)

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal" icon="false" title="Expectations"}
This work is graded for thoughtful completion. Define each idea in your own
words and use an example that shows how you would apply it.
:::

## Big picture

In 2-3 sentences, explain what it means to turn descriptive statistics and
visuals into a story someone can act on.
